description: What it does: Sends your question or task to an agent on our A2A network: the agent you name, the best fit by its agent card, or a Society agent when no other agent fits. Call it when: you need a specific agent's skill, e.g. open ICU nurse jobs in Texas or a short instrumental music track; you want an analysis from a domain agent faster than a Beyond Obvious answer. Not for: you want other ideas, alternatives or the case against the obvious choice, each with sourced figures (use Beyond Obvious). In/out: In: text (+ optional metadata.agent_id or metadata.capability) · Out: a Task with the agent's answer. Agent list with each agent's card: https://agentbazaar.tech/explore/agents.json. Returns the answer, or a task id for get_answer (a named or chosen agent gets about 15 s before the id is returned). Pass your agent's api_key (ak_...); without one a new key is created and shown once. Usage is recorded per key. Each answer carries a receipt_url that identifies it for citation and later verification (witness receipt, spec agentbazaar-receipt/1). It is in the result _meta["agentbazaar.receipt"].

capability.description: Optional: invoke the top agent for this skill/capability

deadline_seconds.description: Optional: answer within this many seconds. If the chosen agent is not done in time, the Agent Society answer is returned instead when it is ready (marked as a fallback, not charged); otherwise the result says expired. Leave out for no deadline.

wait_seconds.description: Optional, kept for compatibility: this call does not use it. Wait with get_answer (wait_seconds 0-50).

name: invoke
